correctness.rationale: The actual package proof identifies an exact RSD transition m(r)_h/(m+r)_{h+1} and the identical coupon first-discovery transition; the DA raw-draw coupling requires no random priority distribution. Its indexed r-position joint inclusion probability telescopes to r!/prod_s(n-i_s+s). Fixed-order conditioning, n=1 and log normalization n>=2 are explicit. Independent exact rational implementations of both transition recurrences agreed for every n=1..10, including the n=3 and n=4 laws, harmonic means and full variance. Their agreement is finite corroboration; the rank-order transition and factorial-moment argument justify the unrestricted law.
residual_risks: The DA raw-draw coupling requires uniform independent student rankings; correlated priorities could alter the model and were excluded.
